realHelp: Complete short texts from the checked local library. The whole text is shown before you prepare a lesson.
technicalHelp: Neutral test texts for checking the workflow. They are not religious content.
aiNote: A lesson made from this text is an AI draft until a person reviews it against the source.
unsupportedTitle: This item cannot be used for a lesson
unsupported: It is not one of the complete short sources prepared for lessons. Quran, translations and books are not available for lesson generation. Choose a listed source instead. Requested:
fallbackNote: No published source is available right now, so the first technical example is selected. It is not religious content.
textPlaceholder: Type or paste your Arabic lesson text here…
textHelp: Balligh keeps your text exactly as written and prepares the lesson from this text only.
referenceHelp: Your own description of the source, for example a book and page. It is shown with the lesson as your claim; Balligh does not verify it.
aiNotice: Balligh writes an AI draft from your text only. It is not reviewed: compare every card with your text before giving it to learners.
libraryHeading: Or choose a text from the library

error.empty: Add your Arabic lesson text first.
error.overLimit: This text is longer than one lesson allows. Shorten it to at most {{maxWords}} words and {{maxChars}} characters.
error.tooLong: This text is too long for one lesson. Shorten it and try again; your text is unchanged.
error.fragmented: This text splits into too many separate sentences for one lesson. Shorten it or join related sentences; your text is unchanged.
error.title: The title is too long. Shorten it and try again.
error.reference: The source description is too long. Shorten it and try again.
error.notArabic: Balligh prepares lessons from Arabic text. Add the Arabic text you teach from.
error.network: The local server could not be reached. Your text is unchanged.
error.generic: Your text could not be prepared. It is unchanged; try again.
error.quran: This text quotes a verse of the Quran. Balligh does not make a lesson that would translate a Quran verse; read the published translations in the Quran reader.

teacherLabel: Teacher-supplied text — not verified by Balligh
teacherReference: Reference given by the teacher (not verified)
ownText: Write or paste my own text
quranFound: This text appears to quote the Quran. Balligh never writes its own translation of a Quran verse; read the published translations in the Quran reader:
quranMaybe: This text may quote the Quran in a way Balligh could not identify. Check any verse yourself; the lesson must not translate it.

store.unreadable: Your earlier unsent text could not be read in this browser. It was left as it was; what you type now is not saved until you choose.
store.corrupt: Your earlier unsent text is damaged and cannot be shown. It was left as it was; what you type now is not saved until you choose.
store.writeFailed: Your text could not be saved in this browser. It stays here while this page is open.
store.discard: Discard it and save from now on
